floral_infrastructure_tpu_95a.structural_purpose: Structural elements (Plate 1). Capped at 3.5mm3/s volumetric flow speed backed by a 15mm prime pillar loop to maintain stable nozzle pressure across varying geometries, preventing spline under-extrusion errors.

sanitary_pouches_soft_tpu_85a.structural_purpose: Flexible wall storage units (Plate 3). Sliced in soft 85A TPU over the textured PEI sheet to lock in a suede-like satin finish that matches premium ceramics.

meal_prep_containers_food_safe_pp.structural_purpose: Food-contact elements (Plate 2). Incorporates a specialized thermal quenching end-script that triggers internal auxiliary room fans at 100% speed while dropping bed heaters to zero instantly. This rapid cooling freezes the Polypropylene strands into a non-crystalline, flexible state to prevent living hinge cracks.
